==Quest information==

===Objectives===
* Enter [[The Catacombs|the catacombs]] and destroy the [[Blood Fanatic]]s.  
* Destroy 3...0 more Blood Fanatic(s).
* Return to [[Kasha Blackblood]] for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* Kasha will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
**{{skill icon|Blood Renewal}}
**{{skill icon|Vampiric Touch}}

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

== Walkthrough ==
After taking the quest from Kasha Blackblood, the closest outpost to the fanatics is [[Barradin Estate]]. Exit the outpost and go straight north from there, following the quest marker. Cross at the second bridge, just next to the entrance to the Catacombs. Then go straight east (see quest map) and you should find the fanatics.

An alternative is to map travel to [[Ashford Abbey]] and enter the Catacombs there. There is a hidden passage just to the right after entering the area that goes behind [[Necromancer Munne]]. In the cavern at the end, follow the long path in front with [[gargoyle]]s all along the way. The path leads west before taking a turn to the north. At some point you will reach a path split. The quest marker will direct you to the stairs leading to a crypt to the right, where the fanatics are located.

The fanatics themselves shouldn't pose any serious threat, dispose of them before returning to Kasha for your reward.
